# Ashleigh Duncan Counselling & Somatic Wellness

> Bespoke therapy practice in Newtownabbey, Northern Ireland, led by Ashleigh Duncan MBACP.
> Offers counselling, somatic experiencing, wellness coaching and reiki, face to face and online.

## About
- Practice name: Ashleigh Duncan Counselling & Somatic Wellness (also known as AD Counselling & Wellness)
- Founder: Ashleigh Duncan, MBACP registered counsellor, 15+ years in practice
- Associate: Andrea Black, MBACP registered counsellor
- Location: 161 Antrim Road, Glengormley, Newtownabbey, BT36 7QR, Northern Ireland
- Phone: 028 9083 9110
- Areas served: Newtownabbey, Glengormley, Belfast, Northern Ireland, Ireland, United Kingdom, and online worldwide
- Services: individual counselling and therapy, somatic experiencing, trauma therapy, wellness coaching, reiki and energy work
- Book: Ashleigh is the author of "A Stripper Called Bambi", an Amazon bestselling self development book
